description: My heart is full. Our campaign is officially kicked off. And we absolutely crushed it with a sold-out crowd that packed the room and then some at Frank Guido's Little Italy in Kingston, NY. A special thank you to my hosts, Mario Catalano and Anne Guerin Catalano, for helping make this night possible. Seeing so many people show up in my hometown to support our vision is something I will never forget. This is the momentum we are building across the Hudson Valley. Our campaign is all about the Big 3: Making life AFFORDABLE, holding leadership ACCOUNTABLE, and creating real OPPORTUNITY here at home! And let this be known - The only thing I’m selling out is events! The Hudson Valley is ours, and we’re taking it back!! Join us at WinWithJackie.com 🇺🇸
